description: Revert to the proven aggressive learning rate configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as historical data confirms this setup achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, whereas the conservative LR (0.08) used in the current best run (0.9800) likely under-utilized the time by converging too slowly.
